title: Local finite presentation descends along a flat surjective locally finitely presented source map
statement: Let $X′,X,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $q:X′\to X$ and $f:X\to S$ be morphisms, and assume $q$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. If $f\circ q$ is locally of finite presentation, then $f$ is locally of finite presentation. No quasi-compactness, separation or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed; empty schemes are allowed.

source.place: LocallyOfFinitePresentation.of_comp_of_flat_of_surjective, lines 127-152; Stacks Project Descent, Tag 02KL, lemma-flat-finitely-presented-permanence, locally finite presentation case.

proof.text: Use the existing proved source declaration LocallyOfFinitePresentation.of_comp_of_flat_of_surjective with exactly the displayed hypotheses. Its proof first treats affine source, intermediate scheme and base: the coordinate map of q is flat, finitely presented and surjective on spectra, hence faithfully flat; the finitely presented composite then gives finite presentation of the intermediate algebra by Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation_of_faithfullyFlat.

For affine intermediate scheme and base, openness of the flat locally finitely presented q gives a cover of the intermediate affine by images of affine source opens. Quasi-compactness selects finitely many of these. Their coproduct is affine, and its induced map is flat, surjective and locally of finite presentation; the composite is locally of finite presentation, by Zariski source locality on its open components. Apply the all-affine case. In general restrict around each point to an affine source neighbourhood mapping into an affine base neighbourhood. Target restriction preserves the hypotheses on q and source restriction preserves those on its composite. Apply the preceding case to these neighbourhoods and then Zariski source locality to f. Empty targets give empty point-indexed covers, so the proof also includes that case.
